verdict.rationale: Slack's first-party docs describe an App Directory of over 2,600 prebuilt apps, including Salesforce, Jira, Google Drive, GitHub and Zendesk. They also say these can be connected in a few clicks, and a help article, "Add apps to your Slack workspace", covers adding them, with index terms for administrators and approving apps. That clearly delivers the core of the story for a team admin. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the admin-side install and approval flow (only implied by help-article keywords), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the install experience.
